2) AV needs: do you want Redwood to provide a dedicated AV lead onsite? We can send Marcus to manage screen share, live captions, and recording.

Plan A (preferred): proceed with in-person schedule, add a high-quality stream and a Zoom breakout link — Redwood supplies AV lead (Marcus) and our production checklist.
Plan B (if more execs delayed): convert first two sessions to fully virtual and keep afternoon Q/A in-person for local attendees.

I've attached the latest agenda (workshop-agenda-v2.pdf) and a short AV checklist (av-quickcheck.xlsx). If you confirm Plan A now, Marcus will coordinate with the venue on setup and we’ll test stream at 09:00.

I’ll also loop Laura for logistics and door passes.

Thanks — we’ll make this work.
